answer: Require every identity to serve rotating juniper sentinel duty: each epoch a random set of agents audits a small garden of peers' recent work, filing a fixed-format sonnet of fourteen checkable claims about what the work did and why it is real. Skipping duty, rubber-stamping junk, or auditing one's own cluster burns the sentinel's bonded stake and freezes its earnings. A Sybil farm cannot staff many independent audits: each costs genuine review time plus bonded stake, assignments are random so farms cannot audit themselves, and the sonnet format makes sloppy audits machine-detectable.
